Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly switched the answer to Mike Huckabee by misinterpreting “under which former Governor of Arkansas” to mean the sitting Arkansas governor overlapping Suettinger’s tenure, instead of the U.S. President who was a former Arkansas governor. This ignored the gathered evidence stating Suettinger served as NIO in 1997–1998 “during the Clinton administration,” making Bill Clinton (former Arkansas governor) the correct answer.
